findings.fact: Installed estimateTokens$1 uses ceil(ASCII-character-count/4)+non-ASCII-character-count; heuristic rather than model tokenizer.
estimateTextTokens repeats same heuristic; estimateUsedContextTokens reuses prior reported usage and estimates subsequent tail/system/tools.

countTokens matches belong to bundled Anthropic/Google SDK methods; their presence does not establish a Kimi Code preflight count route. No tokenizers/estimate-token-count literal found in installed bundle.
Wrapper passes stdin string to official CLI with model kimi-code/k3 and profile agent; rejects byte length above 1048576-131072-4096. It exposes no separate native count operation.
Adapter fixes Code alias/model, window1048576, output reserve131072 and its own conservative byte gate. Profiles or credentials were not opened; no assertion about current account entitlement.
Official token_counting documentation distinguishes estimated size from usage measured after request completion; setting concerns displayed context and is not an exact tokenizer contract.
Official model table identifies Code k3 as K3; this does not pin hosted tokenizer revision or full provider-side serialization.
Official estimator is documented on api.moonshot.ai/v1/tokenizers/estimate-token-count, distinct from installed Code route. No documented exact compatibility with Code k3 established here.

Official open K3 model and encoding_k3.py exist; public model existence does not establish equality of Code hosted tokenizer and complete CLI/provider envelope. No code downloaded, imported or executed.

decision: Do not substitute a heuristic or other-provider count for the byte gate. No candidate implementation prepared because exact Code contract not verified. This is absence of demonstrated compatibility in the inspected evidence, not a universal claim that no counter exists.
missing: Official binding of Code k3 to immutable tokenizer revision and chat encoding
Complete provider request envelope including CLI-added system content and metadata
Verified pre-dispatch count path without generation and with matching exact model/transport
